author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m framing this wall so that my Schluter LED shower niches will fit properly. I frame the niche height 1-1/2 inches taller then add extra 2x4s to the top plate and sides. This allows the niche flange to be supported and the electrical box to fit. I customize two 12x28 LED niches to be one big niche using KERDI-FIX. Then I waterproof it with ALL-SET and KERDI-BAND. But any shower niche always starts with proper framing
title: Schluter LED Shower Niche Framing Tips - #showerniche #showerremodel #sponsored ored
